Geometry-derived analysis shows both Mn and Rh centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each, with neighbor distances near 2.61 Å. The Mn environment includes 4 Mn and 8 Rh neighbors, while Rh has 6 Mn and 6 Rh neighbors.
